name: tvcmall-mcp
description: TVCMALL (ecommerce suppliers): me, get_product, quote_shipping, get_order. Every tool maps to a docu

platform_mcp_tvcmall_authorization_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TVCMALL_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN
platform_mcp_tvcmall_authorization_token.description: AuthorizationToken returned by GET https://openapi.tvc-mall.com/Authorization/GetAuthorization?email=…&password=… once your account manager has enabled the OPEN API (1-3 working days). Sent as `Authorization: TVC <token>` ('The authorization string must start with the prefix "TVC"').

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe reads the top-level category list (GET /OpenApi/Category/GetChildren without ParentCode), so `account` is {CateoryList}. A rejected token answers HTTP 200 {Message: 'unauthorized'}, reported as auth_error.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /OpenApi/Product/Detail?ItemNo= — `id` is the ItemNo (SKU, e.g. 660166037C). ProductStatus: 1 Normal, 2 Out of Stock, 3 Locked, 4 Pre-sold, 5 Group-buy; PriceList gives the quantity price breaks (raw.PriceList). Prices are in the account currency (not returned here). Images are in GET /OpenApi/Product/DetailWithImages (not mapped).

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: POST /order/shippingcost {skuinfo: 'ItemNo*quantity', countrycode (ISO-2)}: Shippings [{ShippingMethodCode, ShippingMethod, ShippingCost, DeliveryCycle}] in the response Currency (raw is not returned; USD by default). Pass `quantity` explicitly: skuinfo is left out without it. When no freight exists the platform answers Success false with a Reason and an empty list.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /order/Info?orderid= (e.g. V23120200014): OrderID, Currency, OriginalAmount, DiscountedAmount (amount due), ShippingMethodName, OrderAddressInfo, Trackingnumbers[], CreatedOn, ModifiedOn, Items[{SKU, Name, UnitPrice, Quantity, Subtotal}]. The response has no status field (status is null).
